labels: Independent review of 1an r4. Hand recomputation; formal / model-relative; generalization measured on strict observations only; not empirical proof.
spec_fidelity_notes: Recurrence, INSUFFICIENT, LOCO train/table/predict/abstain, coverage, disjoint support and the operation test are implemented exactly as the docstring states.

Spec gap: how votes from several minimum guards are combined is not specified. The code takes the union of votes from the guards that can vote and predicts iff that union is a single outcome. This is decisive for RAISE and SUPERSEDE BASE.
Ambiguity: 'include the full-data minimum guard' when there are several full-data minima. The code uses any. No numeric effect on this data.
The R-44 event matches the docstring coding (the extra fields s=t='n/a', h=c=UNK have no effect). Agreement with SPEC-1AM-SUPERSEDE.json is unverifiable.
criterion_divergences: Recurrence: faithful to PRIOR-REVIEW-r3 section 4a. The prior review's own application table (ADOPT a and c HALF) was inconsistent with its criterion; r4's LOOKUP is correct.
LOCO is scored per operation. The prior criterion's per-variable verdict is not derivable, and predictions are not attributed to guards.
The INSUFFICIENT threshold is '< 3 clusters' rather than '2 events or 1 cluster'. No effect on this data.
Disjoint support reports only the pooled R4 count. The prior's cross-cluster-only and per-operation counts are dropped.
The operation test is a new design, not a prior proposal. Its MCR verdict changes the meaning of MCR relative to r3.
D-N1 (START t required by ignorance) is not addressed.

recomputation_detail.operation_test: Comparable pairs: BASE 145 = 15 (AI70) + 15 (RG2) + 15 (OW2) + 4 (git) + 40 (4 START P) + 40 (4 RAISE P) + 16 (ANNOTATE). BASE+R44 155 (+10); REV 142 (+3 E2, +2 E1, -8 L493-B); REV+R44 153 (+11); REV-TYPE 137; REV-TYPE+R44 147. 0 decisive in every variant. Spot-checked pairs: AI70xR72, OW2xE3, gitxOW1, P2xAI89, ANNOTATExR83 (k only), ANNOTATExAI89 (k only), R44xOW1 (k only), REV E1xANNOTATE (k only), REV E2xRG1. All match.

loco_validity: Holding out whole clusters is the right unit, but on this data the method tests the refit procedure rather than the guard. Tiny training sets yield unrelated singleton guards: {a}/{t}/{r} in RAISE fold R-36 from 2 events, {e} in fold R-41, {s} in START fold git. Abstention is structural when the held-out outcome class is absent from training, or when guard values are identity-like. The unspecified voting rule is decisive. RAISE 4/8: the 8 predicted events are 5 P / 3 N, so always-PERFORMED would score 5/8 and a coin 4/8 in expectation. All 4 correct predictions come from the {r} route rule fitted on one pair; the same rule is wrong on R-36's 3 refusals; e's single prediction was wrong. The score is at chance and below the majority rule, and uninformative about e (e=2+ never occurs outside R-36).
start_coverage_assessment: The 2/11 coverage makes LOCO uninformative about s. The fitted guard {s,t} requires the exact (s,t) tuple to recur, and t is a near-unique target identifier, so LOCO amounts to a lookup on (s, target). Both predictions are the one recurring tuple (not-authorized, 7B). t is in the guard only because git's s is UNK (D-N1); the one fold without git in training fits {s}. 's generalizes' rests on recurrence (4 GENERALIZING pairs) and disjoint support 2, not on LOCO. A guard-restricted {s}-only LOCO, with consistency defined as table consistency among s-known training events, would be more informative: authorized always co-occurs with P and not-authorized with N, each across 4 clusters. It would be a new, post-hoc instrument and must be frozen before it is run. Under r3 separating semantics {s} does not separate folds that contain git.
operation_test_assessment: Comparability is not trivially broken (145/248 in BASE), but decisiveness is structurally near-impossible: o co-varies with k, a and r (START is the only EXECUTION operation, L493-B the only PROMOTION event), and several comparable pairs differ only in k. '0 decisive' shows only that o is never the sole difference on a comparable pair; o is confounded with k/a/r. It does not support MODEL-COND-REDUNDANT. Reasons: 103 BASE pairs are untested; ADOPT Chief-declined x ANNOTATE (BASE, REV-TYPE) has no known separator other than o; the only structurally decisive candidate (ANNOTATE x SUPERSEDE R-94) is CHOICE-excluded; and r3's MCR is a hitting-set notion that r4 does not compute. Suggested label: 'o NOT FORCED on comparable pairs; UNDETERMINED'.

r44_effects.SUPERSEDE: Guard {k}|{r} -> {k}. k becomes FR; a goes NEVER -> MCR; r stays MCR. Flags [a,e,k] -> [e,k]. LOCO 2/0/1 -> 0/1/3; stability 2/3 -> 4/4. R-44 refutes {r}'s correct predictions. k recurrence LOOKUP.
r44_effects.other_operations: No change to ADOPT, RAISE, START, ASSIGN-ID, AUTHORIZE-IMPL, OPEN-WORK, REGISTER or ANNOTATE.
r44_effects.operation_test: Power +10 (BASE, REV-TYPE) or +11 (REV); still 0 decisive. R-44 x OW1 differs only in k.
r44_effects.disjoint_support: k 2 -> 3 in every variant. The added contrast (R-44, R-77) is an identity lookup: all SUPERSEDE k values are distinct.

overreach_flags: The 'MODEL-COND-REDUNDANT under MO' operation verdict reads as 'o is redundant'. It only means no decisive pair among comparable pairs.
Guard stability 8/9 (START) and 4/4 (SUPERSEDE+R44) read as robustness. Stability is guard persistence, not predictive success (SUPERSEDE+R44 has 0 correct).
RAISE correct 4 / coverage 0.889 reads as partial generalization of e. The correct predictions all come from {r}, and e's one prediction was wrong.
SUPERSEDE BASE 2/0 reads as generalization. It is the {r} route rule, refuted by R-44.
START s GENERALIZING is formal recurrence on 4 pairs (2 disjoint), target-indexed. It is not empirical confirmation.
disjoint_support k=3 pools two within-cluster contrasts from INSUFFICIENT operations and one identity lookup. The cross-cluster-only count is 1.
recurrence_raw for INSUFFICIENT operations can be cited as a result.
RAISE e HALF-LOOKUP hides the contrary recurrence (e=1 with P in R-41).
RESULT-r4 has no per-operation verdicts, so readers will supply their own. The file-level 'not empirical proof' label is correct.

summary.verdict_note: s: GENERALIZES (recurrence + 2 disjoint; LOCO uninformative). t: DOES NOT GENERALIZE (required by ignorance).
power 145/155/142/153/137/147, 0 decisive; o confounded with k/a/r; not 'redundant'.

disagreements.text: The voting rule across several minimum guards is unspecified. The code's union-of-voters rule drives RAISE (4 correct, 3 wrong from {r}) and SUPERSEDE BASE (2 correct from {r}).
Stability is ambiguous with several full-data minima (the code uses any). No numeric effect.
LOCO is per operation; the prior per-variable verdict cannot be derived, and there is no guard attribution.
INSUFFICIENT is '< 3 clusters' vs the prior '2 events or 1 cluster'. No effect.
Disjoint support is pooled R4 only; the cross-cluster and per-operation counts are dropped. k=3 is two within-cluster contrasts plus one lookup.

The MO verdict MCR overreaches: o is confounded with k/a/r, 103 pairs are untested (including E1 x ANNOTATE, where o is the only known separator), and r3's MCR is a hitting-set notion that is not computed.
'Power' = comparable pairs is not power to detect a decisive pair. The only structural candidate (ANNOTATE x SUPERSEDE R-94) is CHOICE-excluded.
Recurrence ignores contrary recurrence (RAISE e=1 occurs with both outcomes out of cluster).
The prior review's application table (ADOPT a/c HALF, e 'single-cluster') is inconsistent with its own criterion; r4 is faithful.
D-N1 is still open: START t is FR only because git's s is UNK. This causes the {s,t} lookup and the 9/11 abstentions.
R-44 coding: s/t 'n/a' vs UNK (no effect); cluster R-44 vs R-57; SPEC-1AM agreement unverifiable.
recurrence_raw is emitted for INSUFFICIENT operations.
RAISE LOCO 4/8 is at chance and below always-P (5/8). The correct predictions come from a route guard fitted on 2 events; this says nothing about e.
Stability is uninformative for identity-valued guards (SUPERSEDE+R44: 4/4 stable, 0 correct).
Data provenance through models_1al.r4_observations() and SPEC-1AM is unverifiable; OBSERVATIONS.json was taken as exact.
's generalizes' is formal recurrence on strict observations (4 pairs, 2 disjoint, target-indexed), not empirical confirmation.
